nodes.label: WeekCalendar Component
nodes.rationale: WeekCalendar owns all calendar state (currentWeekStart, occurrences, loading) as single source of truth to prevent synchronization bugs; pages become thin configuration wrappers. Self-contained component fetches own data via useEffect triggered on week changes.

nodes.label: FungibleResource DB Model
nodes.rationale: Groups interchangeable physical resources (e.g., all meeting rooms) so capacity checks and calendar queries can operate on the group level rather than individual resources, enabling a single query instead of N queries.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Function: expand_recurring_reservations
nodes.rationale: Handles recurring reservation expansion in SQL using generate_series to produce individual occurrence rows, avoiding N+1 queries from application code for recurring series.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Function: expand_reservations_for_calendar (single resource, OR logic)
nodes.rationale: Collapses multi-step application-level filtering (approved OR user's pending) + recurring expansion + exception handling into a single PostgreSQL function call, reducing 11+ round-trips to 1 and cutting code from 82 to 45 lines.
nodes.norm_label: postgresql function: expand_reservations_for_calendar (single resource, or logic)

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Function: expand_reservations_for_calendar_by_fungible
nodes.rationale: Extends single-resource calendar function to operate on an entire FungibleResource group using IN subquery, reducing N individual resource queries to 1 group query. 80-90% faster for typical resource counts.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Function: expand_reservations_for_calendar_by_type
nodes.rationale: Final evolution: passes only the resource type string; PostgreSQL resolves all fungible groups and resources internally. API code reduces to ~5 lines per endpoint. Eliminates the application-side fungible resource lookup from the critical path.

nodes.label: ResourceType Enum (Deprecated)
nodes.rationale: Hardcoded MEETING/AUDITORIUM/COWORKING/LAB enum being removed from schema, SQL functions, and all application code. Replaced by Space model + FungibleResource FK to enable dynamic, DB-driven space configuration.

nodes.label: JWT Session Strategy
nodes.rationale: Adopted in Next.js middleware because edge runtime cannot access database; middleware uses getToken() from next-auth/jwt. Stateless verification without DB round-trip enables auth checks in Vercel edge network.

nodes.label: Database Session Strategy
nodes.rationale: Recommended over JWT for La Nube main app: supports instant role revocation, real-time permission changes, and full session audit. Coworking scale does not require JWT's horizontal scalability benefits.

nodes.label: EventsGrid Component (Paginated)
nodes.rationale: Replaces scroll-snap EventsCarousel with a responsive paginated grid (1/2/3/4 columns via Tailwind breakpoints). Page size adapts to column count on mount to minimize layout shift. Includes asterisk badge for events with exceptions.

nodes.label: expandAllEventOccurrences (TS function)
nodes.rationale: Variant of expandEventOccurrences that passes nowMs=0 to include past occurrences. Used on public event detail page to show full session agenda including historical sessions.

nodes.label: SpacesSection Landing Component (DB-driven)
nodes.rationale: Replaces static ServicesSection; fetches spaces from DB at SSR time via getPublicSpaces(). Featured space renders as full-width card; remaining spaces in 3-column grid. Returns null when no spaces exist.

nodes.label: Intellymation Partner Logo
nodes.description: Logo of Intellymation, a company/partner. The logo features a blue geometric icon (two overlapping parallelogram/arrow shapes) on the left, and the company name 'Intellymation' in dark navy blue sans-serif text on the right, split across two lines as 'Intelly' and 'mation'.

nodes.label: KEA DESIGN S.R.L. – Ingeniería Electrónica partner logo
nodes.description: Logo for KEA DESIGN S.R.L., an electronic engineering company (Ingeniería Electrónica). Features a circular outline enclosing the monogram initials 'KD' rendered in a salmon-to-coral gradient. Below the emblem the full company name 'KEA DESIGN S.R.L.' appears in bold, followed by the subtitle 'INGENIERÍA ELECTRÓNICA' in lighter weight. Overall color palette is salmon/coral-to-orange gradient on a white background.
nodes.norm_label: kea design s.r.l. – ingenieria electronica partner logo

nodes.label: MSI Partner Logo
nodes.description: Logo of MSI, a partner organization. The logo features an abstract blue symbol consisting of five circular nodes connected by curved flowing paths arranged symmetrically, suggesting interconnection or community. The design uses a solid navy/cobalt blue color on a white background. MSI is a partner/sponsor displayed on the lanube coworking space platform.

nodes.label: Proguide
nodes.description: Proguide partner logo. Teal/mint color scheme with the wordmark 'Proguide' in a light sans-serif font alongside a stylized 'P' icon resembling a curved arrow or page-turn symbol. Used as a partner/sponsor logo on the lanube platform.

nodes.label: Tecso – Partner Logo
nodes.description: Logo of Tecso, a technology company. Displayed as the wordmark '.tecso' in bold rounded sans-serif typography, rendered in solid orange (#E8621A). The leading dot before the 't' is a distinctive brand element. Used as a partner logo on the lanube platform.

nodes.label: Stock photo: La Nube coworking space in use — multiple people working at open-plan desks with laptops, modern white ergonomic chairs, desk dividers, exposed brick walls, large windows, indoor plants, and a projector screen displaying Spanish-language content ('minutos'); warm natural daylight; lively but focused atmosphere
nodes.visual_description: Photograph taken inside a coworking space. Six or more people — men and women of various ages — are seated at rows of long white desks separated by low grey dividers, each working on a laptop. The furniture is modern: white frame ergonomic mesh chairs with tan seat cushions. Walls are exposed brick; tall glass windows fill the left side with bright natural daylight. A large projector screen on the back wall shows a slide with the word 'minutos' and other Spanish text, suggesting a training session or workshop is in progress. A green tropical plant adds a natural accent near the windows. A fire extinguisher and emergency-exit sign are visible. The overall atmosphere is professional, productive, and community-oriented.
nodes.norm_label: stock photo: la nube coworking space in use — multiple people working at open-plan desks with laptops, modern white ergonomic chairs, desk dividers, exposed brick walls, large windows, indoor plants, and a projector screen displaying spanish-language content ('minutos'); warm natural daylight; lively but focused atmosphere

nodes.label: Next.js Wordmark SVG
nodes.description: Official Next.js framework wordmark logo rendered as an SVG. Displays the text 'NEXT.JS' in solid black on a transparent background (394x80 viewBox). Uses filled path data to form the letters N, E, X, T, J, S — the standard Next.js brand asset typically used in footers, README files, and 'built with' sections.

nodes.label: Vercel Logo SVG
nodes.description: Official Vercel deployment platform logo. A minimal SVG containing a single white upward-pointing triangle (the canonical Vercel logomark) on a transparent background. Dimensions 1155x1000 viewBox. Used in the Next.js default public assets and referenced in the project as a static brand asset.

nodes.label: Window / Browser UI Icon (SVG)
nodes.description: A 16x16 SVG icon depicting a browser or application window. It shows a rectangular outer frame (full 16x16 viewBox) with a rounded inner panel and three small circular dots (radius 0.75) in the upper-left area, resembling macOS-style traffic-light window controls. The icon is rendered in gray (#666) with fill-rule evenodd. Commonly used as a UI icon to represent a browser window, app window, or desktop application context.
